title_en: 2026 AI Hacking Defense Contest (2026 ACDC): Call for Preliminary Round Participants
summary: Anyone of Republic of Korea nationality aged 19 or over who is interested in AI and cybersecurity may enter the 2026 AI Hacking Defense Contest (2026 ACDC); this is optional, not mandatory. The online preliminary round takes place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, from 09:00 to 17:00, and the final round on Tuesday, 1 December 2026, at the Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas (Samseong-dong, Seoul). The notice does not state how or by when to register; registration details may be in the attached poster, which was not read.
applies_to: Optional (not mandatory). Open only to persons of Republic of Korea nationality aged 19 or over who are interested in AI and cybersecurity, in two categories: General (employees of government or public institutions and private companies, etc.) and Student (enrolled students or students on leave of absence at universities or graduate schools located in Korea).

dates.what: Final round, at Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas (Samseong-dong, Seoul)

conditions: Only persons of Republic of Korea nationality may participate.
Participants must be aged 19 or over.
The Student category is limited to enrolled students or students on leave of absence at universities or graduate schools located in Korea.
The General category is for employees of government or public institutions and private companies, etc.
steps: Read the attached poster (2026 AI해킹방어대회(2026 ACDC) 포스터.pdf); its content was not read for this translation, and the notice text itself does not state how or by when to register.
Take part in the online preliminary round on 31 October 2026, from 09:00 to 17:00.
translation:
2026 AI Hacking Defense Contest (2026 ACDC): Call for Preliminary Round Participants

The 2026 ACDC (AI Cyber Defense Contest, AI 해킹방어대회), hosted by the Ministry of Science and ICT and jointly organised by the Korea Internet & Security Agency and the Korea Information Security Industry Association, will be held.

A. Event name: 2026 AI Hacking Defense Contest (2026 ACDC)

B. Theme: AI everywhere, Cybersecurity Always.

C. Preliminary round (online): Saturday, 31 October 2026, 09:00–17:00

D. Final round: Tuesday, 1 December 2026, Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas (Samseong-dong, Seoul)

E. Eligibility: Anyone of Republic of Korea nationality aged 19 or over who is interested in AI and cybersecurity
1) General category: employees working at government or public institutions and private companies, etc.
2) Student category: enrolled students or students on leave of absence at universities (or graduate schools) located in Korea

Attachment (1 file): 2026 AI해킹방어대회(2026 ACDC) 포스터.pdf (718 KB) [2026 ACDC poster]. The content of this attachment was not read.
